name: Norma F. Pfriem Summer Day Camp
description_short: A weekly summer day camp at the Shehan Center in Bridgeport that mixes sports, swimming, arts and performing arts with math, STEM and literacy classes, plus special events and field trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is one of the camp activities, using the Shehan Center's own facilities. The page gives no pool or supervision details.

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). Dates for 2027 are not posted yet.
Session dates have no year on the page. 2026 is assumed from "Summer Camp 2026 registration opens on February 1, 2026".
Basketball and Swim Camps (Aug 17–21) appear to be separate specialty programs with their own flyers, not part of the regular day camp sessions.
Pricing, ages and other details are in a linked Registration and Information Packet that was not provided.
The center says it is exempt from day care licensing under Conn. Public Act 11-193.
